site_subtitle: Meaning of Life vs. World-Problem Score
error_invalid: Please enter valid, positive numbers (nice things and participants must be > 0).
meaning_wins: The meaning of life (42) outweighs the world-problem score! 🎉
problems_win: The world-problem score outweighs the meaning of life. 😬
explain_p1: 42 is famously the answer to the ultimate question of life, the universe, and everything. This site pragmatically checks whether that "meaning of life" still outweighs the problems of the world in everyday life.
explain_p2: You enter three values: how many people were counting along, how many general world problems you noticed, and how many nice circumstances or events you found in return.
explain_p3: From this the site calculates a "world-problem score": 42 × problems ÷ nice things ÷ participants. If this score is lower than 42, the meaning of life wins. If it's higher, the problems win (at least in feeling).
